subject: A website concept for Headline Barber Shop
body:
Hi Headline Barber Shop team,

I came across your business in Waterloo, Ontario, Canada and built an independent website concept around your publicly listed services. It brings the service overview and phone contact into one mobile-friendly page.

Preview: https://headline-waterloo.muhammadmuneeb.tech/

This is a design proposal, not your live business website. If the direction is useful, I'd be happy to discuss adapting it for your business.

Muhammad Muneeb
Portfolio: https://muhammadmuneeb.tech/
LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/muhammad-muneeb-yaseen
GitHub: https://github.com/Muneeb50702

If this isn't relevant, reply 'no thanks' and I won't follow up.
